text:
maya: heads-up everyone 50deploy tonight 23:45 UTC: kernel v2.14.1 + quant bundle qf-2026-03b. rollout plan: 0.5% -> 3% -> 20% -> 100% with a 7m hold at each step. auto-pin if client error-rate >0.4% sustained 6m. cross-region swap requires manual OK from ryan. preflight starts 23:15 UTC.

deploybot: scheduled: job=deploy-5185012345 preflight=23:15 UTC. will run prebake, smoke, and perf microbench. will publish /status updates here.

ryan: noted. two things: (1) matmul ABI v2 requires shims for older runtime families; those shims are in place but only cover ~1.8% of traffic. (2) thermal profile changed slightly in v2.14.1, monitor GPU core temp and power draw.

kevin: ops checklist: prepare quick pin for enterprise tenants `deployctl tenant-pin --tenant-id <id> --kernel v2.13` and pre-create rollback ticket template.

maya: release notes snippet: "matmul micro-optimizations, ~10-15% perf on medium-sequence loads; KV-cache writeback fix; minor quant numeric drift corrections". I'll post RN after 20% step.

deploybot: preflight PASS at 23:18 UTC. prebake ok, smoke ok, perf microbench within expected variance. checksum verified. canary scheduled 23:45 UTC 0.5%.

tom: small flag 50the quant bundle touches batcher alignment. Sasha, can you run the kv-consistency suite on canary nodes? I can run a quick harness: `./infra/test_kv_consistency --nodes=canary`

sasha: will run harness at start of canary and report back. plan to tail kv-miss logs and check evictions.

deploybot: canary 0.5% started 23:45:12 UTC. metrics: https://internal.redwood/metrics/deploy-5185012345. tagging #eng-runtime and #eng-sre.

maya: SRE, please watch p99, 5xx, kv-miss-rate, and GPU-temp. If any gate exceeds thresholds, call manual pin and we'll hold.

ops-oncall: oncall here. will monitor circuit-breakers and memory OOM alerts for first 10m after each promotion. holdpoints logged in runbook: /docs/runbooks/runtime/release-window.md

ryan: can we set sticky pin TTL 3h for region-us-west if manual pin triggered? we'll need time to collect traces.

deploybot: sticky pin configured: `deploybot pin set --id deploy-5185012345 --ttl 3h --scope region-us-west` (applies on manual or auto-pin).

kevin: pushed rollback template to ticketing: title "ROLLBACK deploy-5185012345", includes command: `/deploy rollback deploy-5185012345 --reason "health gate breach"` and checklist for customer notification.

sasha: canary health quick report (23:51 UTC): p99 +3.1%, 5xx flat, kv-miss +0.05% absolute. no evictions. proceeding to 3% at 23:53 UTC unless blocked.

maya: thanks. waiting for ryan to OK cross-region swap before >20%.

ryan: OK to proceed to 20% after 3% holds for 7m with no gate violations. I'll be available for manual cross-region approval at 00:30 UTC.

deploybot: promoted to 3% at 23:53:22 UTC. next hold scheduled 7m then auto-promote to 20% unless blocked.

sasha: 00:01 UTC check-in: p99 +4.8% (within 8% gate), 5xx +0.02% (within gate), GPU temp nominal. nothing blocking.

maya: creating postmortem stub now at /docs/postmortems/runtime/deploy-5185012345.md per request so we have fields ready if needed. assigning to ops-oncall.

deploybot: auto-promote to 20% at 00:01:22 UTC. telemetry link: https://internal.redwood/metrics/deploy-5185012345?step=20.

kevin: customers with strict SLAs: pre-applied model-pin notice sent. ops will hold off tenant-level pinning unless we see anomalies.

ops-oncall: monitoring live. I see a tiny uptick in kv-cache miss ratio on one canary shard (~0.15% absolute) but traffic-weighted it's negligible. watching for growth.

maya: if kv-miss hits +0.5% absolute in any region, trigger manual pin and open rollback ticket.

deploybot: 00:20 UTC 50post-promotion checks stable at 20%. schedule for 100% roll at 00:40 UTC with final hold. please flag any last-minute concerns.

ryan: no blockers from my side. I will approve cross-region swap at 00:29 UTC if metrics remain stable.

maya: thanks all. RN will be published to #release-notes once 100% done. standby for post-rollout verification for 30m.

deploybot: final promotion to 100% completed 00:40:15 UTC. rollout summary: no gate breaches, no auto-pins, sticky pin ready if manually invoked. metrics snapshot: https://internal.redwood/metrics/deploy-5185012345/summary. :party_parrot:
